label: Run Model
description: Run any model endpoint registered in the Model Hub: chat, image, 3D, audio, an HTTP API or a command-line tool.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.description: Text prompt / instruction for the model.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: Image input (asset, file path or data URI).

inputs.name: params
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Extra parameters as a JSON object, merged over the node's own parameters.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model Override
inputs.description: Overrides the configured model endpoint at runtime.

outputs.name: out
outputs.label: Result
outputs.description: The main result: the produced asset, or the text for text models.

outputs.name: asset
outputs.label: Asset
outputs.description: The produced asset (image, mesh, audio, file), if any.

outputs.name: text
outputs.label: Text
outputs.description: Text returned by the model, if any.

outputs.name: path
outputs.label: File Path
outputs.description: Local path of the produced file.

outputs.name: all
outputs.label: All Assets
outputs.description: List of every asset produced when the model returns several.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.

properties.label: Prompt
properties.placeholder: Used when nothing is wired into Prompt
